ghi: Cảnh Thang máy phim #132 viết lại theo ngữ pháp ReelShort (tham-khao/reelshort.md): mỗi mảnh MỘT việc 1–2 s, hành động tiếp xúc kể bằng chuỗi cắt (trước chạm → cận chi tiết → phản ứng), thoại mới dài hơn. Không 3D. vao = điểm vào clip (giây) chọn sau khi xem clip — bản dựng lấy đoạn phát từ đó.

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Toàn sảnh: Hạ ôm thùng đồ đứng chờ trước cửa thang máy thép
shot.anh: Wide shot of the black marble elevator lobby: Hạ, in a white blouse with a coffee stain, stands alone hugging a cardboard box of her belongings in front of the closed brushed-steel elevator door, staff ID badge on a dark blue lanyard around her neck.
shot.vid: Hạ stands still, waiting, shifting the box slightly in her arms. Static camera.
shot.mo: Hạ stands still in front of the closed steel elevator door, hugging the box
shot.ket: Hạ lifts her eyes up toward the floor indicator above the door

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Cận mặt Hạ: bình thản, mắt nhìn lên bảng số tầng
shot.anh: Close-up of Hạ's calm face, eyes lifted toward the elevator floor indicator above frame, black marble wall behind.
shot.vid: Hạ watches the floor indicator, calm; she hears heels approaching and her eyes slide to her right. Static camera.
shot.mo: Hạ's eyes are already lifted to the floor indicator
shot.ket: the click of high heels approaches from her right; Hạ's eyes slide to screen right toward the sound

shot.hd: Vivian bước vào khung từ bên phải, nhếch môi
shot.anh: Medium shot: Vivian in a fitted burgundy office dress walks into the black marble lobby from the right, a smug half smile.
shot.vid: Vivian walks two steps toward camera-left with a smug half smile. Camera tracks slightly with her.
shot.mo: Vivian is already striding in from the right edge of frame
shot.ket: Vivian fixes her eyes on Hạ at screen left and smirks as she closes in

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Cận Hạ liếc sang phải, nhận ra Vivian
shot.anh: Close-up of Hạ turning her eyes to the right, wary.
shot.vid: Hạ watches Vivian come close, wary, her jaw tightening; then her eyes drop as Vivian's hand reaches toward her badge. Static camera.
shot.mo: Hạ is already looking toward screen right at Vivian coming close
shot.ket: Hạ's eyes drop to her own chest as a red-nailed hand reaches in from the right toward her badge

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Cận chèn: bàn tay Vivian túm lấy thẻ nhân viên trên ngực Hạ
shot.anh: Extreme close-up insert, tight on the white plastic staff ID badge hanging on its dark blue lanyard against Hạ's white blouse, just above the cardboard box: Vivian's hand with red nails and a burgundy sleeve reaches in from the right and her fingers are wrapped firmly around the badge card itself. Only the badge, the lanyard and Vivian's hand are in focus; no face in frame; nobody else's hand.
shot.vid: Vivian's fingers tighten their grip on the badge card and give it a short sharp tug toward the right, pulling the lanyard taut. Only her hand moves; Hạ's hands stay on the box out of frame. Static camera.
shot.mo: Vivian's red-nailed fingers close around the badge card
shot.ket: Vivian yanks the badge sharply to the right and the lanyard snaps taut

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Cận Hạ giật mình, đầu hơi chúi về trước
shot.anh: Close-up of Hạ, startled, her head jolted slightly forward.
shot.vid: Hạ's head jolts forward a little and her eyes widen for a beat. Static camera.
shot.mo: Hạ's head jolts forward from the yank
shot.ket: Hạ's eyes drop to look down at what was taken from her

shot.hd: Cận chèn: thẻ nằm trong nắm tay Vivian, dây đeo hở hai đầu lủng lẳng
shot.anh: Insert close-up: Vivian's fist holds the white staff ID badge, its dark blue lanyard snapped open, two loose ends dangling, black marble background.
shot.vid: The two loose lanyard ends sway gently below Vivian's fist. Static camera.
shot.mo: the snapped lanyard ends swing below Vivian's fist
shot.ket: the fist begins to rise up and out of frame

shot.hd: Vivian cười đắc ý, giơ thẻ lên ngang mặt
shot.anh: Medium close-up of Vivian smiling triumphantly, holding the white staff ID badge up beside her face.
shot.vid: Vivian holds the badge up beside her face with a triumphant smile; at the chime her eyes flick to her left toward the elevator, the smile staying on her lips. Static camera.
shot.mo: Vivian raises the badge up beside her face, smiling triumphantly
shot.ket: an elevator chime sounds; Vivian's smile holds but her eyes flick to screen left toward the second elevator

shot.hd: Cửa thang máy 2 mở, Lục Thần bước ra
shot.anh: Medium shot: the second steel elevator door stands open, Lục Thần in a black three-piece suit steps out into the black marble lobby, cold expression.
shot.vid: Lục Thần takes one step out of the elevator toward camera, not looking at anyone. Low angle, static camera.
shot.mo: the second elevator door is already sliding open
shot.ket: Lục Thần strides out toward camera, not looking at anyone

shot.hd: Cận Lục Thần lạnh lùng, không nhìn Hạ
shot.anh: Close-up of Lục Thần, cold eyes looking straight ahead past camera, black marble lobby behind.
shot.vid: Lục Thần speaks without turning his head, face still and cold. Static camera.

thoai.loi: Người ngoài thì đừng đứng chắn thang máy.
thoai.dien_xuat: không dừng bước, không nhìn Hạ

shot.mo: Lục Thần is mid-stride, his cold eyes straight ahead past camera
shot.ket: he finishes the line without once looking at Hạ

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Cận Hạ nén lại, mím môi
shot.anh: Close-up of Hạ pressing her lips together, holding back, eyes lowered.
shot.vid: Hạ presses her lips together and lowers her eyes. Static camera.
shot.mo: Hạ has just heard his words and presses her lips together
shot.ket: Hạ lowers her eyes and stays silent

shot.hd: Vivian lắc tấm thẻ trước mặt, nói khinh miệt
shot.anh: Medium close-up of Vivian dangling the white staff ID badge on its lanyard in front of her, mocking smile.
shot.vid: Vivian holds the lanyard up and swings the badge slowly left and right in front of her like a pendulum, a composed contemptuous smile the whole time, speaking slowly and coldly. Her face stays smug and controlled — no frowning, no grimacing. Static camera.

thoai.loi: Thẻ của công ty. Loại như cô, đừng mơ bước vào toà nhà này lần nữa.

shot.mo: Vivian is already swinging the badge on its lanyard in front of Hạ
shot.ket: Vivian finishes and tilts her head, waiting for Hạ to break

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Cận Hạ ngẩng lên, khẽ nhếch môi, nói
shot.anh: Close-up of Hạ lifting her eyes, the faintest smirk at the corner of her mouth.
shot.vid: Hạ slowly lifts her eyes to Vivian, calm and composed; one corner of her mouth curls into a faint knowing smirk as she speaks softly; then she turns her head away to her right, toward the elevator. No worry, no frown. Very slow push-in.

thoai.loi: Chị nói đúng. Lần sau, tôi sẽ không đi cửa này.

shot.mo: Hạ slowly lifts her eyes to Vivian
shot.ket: after speaking, Hạ turns away toward screen left, toward the open elevator

shot.hd: Cận Vivian, nụ cười khựng lại
shot.anh: Close-up of Vivian's face only, burgundy dress collar at the bottom of frame, black marble elevator lobby softly blurred behind: she still wears a smug red-lipped smile, eyes on someone just off camera-left. No badge, no hands in frame.
shot.vid: Vivian's smug smile stiffens and slowly drains away; the corners of her mouth drop, her eyes narrow with sudden doubt. Static camera.
shot.mo: Vivian's smile stiffens as Hạ turns away
shot.ket: Vivian's eyes follow Hạ moving away to screen left

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Hạ đứng trong thang máy ôm thùng, cửa thép khép dần
shot.anh: Medium shot from the lobby: Hạ stands inside the elevator car hugging the cardboard box, facing out, the brushed-steel doors open.
shot.vid: The steel elevator doors slide closed in front of Hạ, who stays still facing out. Static camera.
shot.mo: Hạ stands inside the elevator facing out, hugging the box
shot.ket: the steel doors slide shut in front of her calm face
